title: Do a PSR/BPE screening
summary: One code per sextant instead of full probing, and what it suggests.

inputs.examType: Exam type as shown in the list (e.g. "PSR/BPE screening")

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide goes on when their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient.

steps.title: Periodontal chart
steps.details: Opens a new periodontal chart: missing teeth, pontics and implants come from the latest odontogram, and the latest closed chart is the guide.

steps.title: Exam type
steps.details: PSR/BPE screening: one code per sextant instead of the full probing.

steps.title: Choose “PSR/BPE screening”
steps.details: Change the exam type. (With “Implants only”, the probe goes over the implants only.)

steps.title: Sextants
steps.details: In each sextant, the code of the worst site: 0 healthy, 1 bleeds, 2 calculus, 3 pocket of 3.5 to 5.5 mm, 4 deeper, X excluded. The asterisk marks furcation, mobility or recession.

steps.title: What each code means
steps.details: Keyboard: 0–4 or X code the marked sextant and move on.

steps.title: Diagnosis
steps.details: A screening is not classified: the highest code is interpreted.

steps.title: Screening result
steps.details: What the highest code means, what to do and which sextants need a full periodontal chart.

steps.title: Plan
steps.details: Hygiene, professional cleaning or a full periodontal chart depending on the codes.
